v3.1.3 Update
Sharper card and menu text in Iron & Blood, Glass and Zenith. Fixed missing hit effects and false OBS warnings for condition icons. Use Download OBS HTML to update an existing standalone OBS source.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v3.1.3
announcement.content:
v3.1.3 Update

  • Card names, GM List text and Action Menu submenus are easier to read in Iron & Blood, Glass and Zenith.
  • Scene details show through the tint on expanded Glass cards. The arrows beside OPERATING and hovered menu items display correctly.
  • Glass and Iron & Blood cards shake from their current position when hit, including with Mirror Party HUD enabled.
  • Fixed Iron & Blood cards replaying their entrance after a hit in OBS and a false asset warning for condition icons that loaded successfully.

To update an existing OBS Browser Source, open Broadcast Settings, choose Download OBS HTML and replace its local HTML file.
